about: The alleluia of the formulary “Annunciation of the Blessed Virgin Mary” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Alleluia, alleluia. After childbirth you remained a pure virgin, O Mother of God, intercede for us. Alleluia. Blessed and venerable are you, O Virgin Mary, who, with unsullied virginity, were found to be the Mother of the Savior. O Virgin, Mother of God, He Whom the whole world does not contain, becoming man, shut Himself in your womb. Alleluia, alleluia. Hail, full of grace, the Lord is with thee: blessed art thou among women. Allelúja.
